lead.question: 新年夜市政厅的大钟为何停摆？课文标题的“冷遇”究竟指什么？
lead.warmup: 新年夜，人们聚在市政厅的大钟下，等着午夜十二点的钟声把新年迎进来。可就在十一点五十五分，大钟停了，巨大的分针一动不动。人群一直等到十二点零二分才反应过来：大钟“拒绝”敲响十二下，新年受到了冷遇。作者为何偏偏用“拒绝”二字？文末人们为何又笑又唱？
goals: 复述课文：用英语讲清新年夜大钟停摆的整个过程
掌握 a large crowd of、gather、Town Hall、minute hand、strike、refuse to 等核心表达
辨别过去完成时 had gathered 与过去将来时 would strike 在叙事中的作用
区分 at / on / in / during / till 的时间用法，会用 in twenty minutes' time
lead.summary: 本课以一次泡汤的新年倒计时为线索，串起过去完成时 had gathered、过去将来时 would strike、拟人化的 refused to welcome 等表达，并梳理 at、on、in、during、till 引导时间状语的分工。学完你能讲清：人群聚在何处、大钟本该何时敲响、为何 in twenty minutes' time 译作“二十分钟之后”。
lead.tips: 易错：in twenty minutes' time 表“二十分钟之后”，配将来时；钟“敲响”用 strike，过去式 struck，不要写成 striked。

questions.q: What does 'a cold welcome' refer to?
questions.zh: 课文标题中的 a cold welcome（冷遇）指的是什么事？
questions.a: It refers to the big Town Hall clock which stopped at five to twelve and never struck twelve, so it 'refused to welcome the New Year'.
questions.aZh: 指市政厅的大钟在 11 点 55 分停摆，始终没有敲响 12 下，等于“拒绝”迎接新年，新年因此受到冷遇。
questions.hint: 答案出自末句 The big clock refused to welcome the New Year，并结合第 4 句 the clock stopped 理解。

questions.q: Where had the large crowd gathered before midnight, and what were they waiting for?
questions.zh: 午夜前，那一大群人聚集在哪里？他们在等什么？
questions.a: They had gathered under the Town Hall clock, waiting for it to strike twelve and welcome the New Year.
questions.aZh: 他们聚集在市政厅的大钟下面，等着大钟敲响十二下，迎接新年到来。
questions.hint: 见第 2、3 句：under the Town Hall clock 与 It would strike twelve。

questions.q: At what exact time did the clock stop, and what time was it when someone shouted?
questions.zh: 大钟是在几点停的？有人喊叫时又是几点？
questions.a: The clock stopped at five to twelve, and it was two minutes past twelve when someone shouted.
questions.aZh: 大钟在 11 点 55 分停摆；有人喊叫时，时间已是 12 点零 2 分。
questions.hint: 见第 4 句 at five to twelve 和第 6 句 It's two minutes past twelve!

questions.q: Why are 'had gathered' and 'would strike' used instead of 'gathered' and 'will strike'?
questions.zh: 课文为何用 had gathered 和 would strike，而不用 gathered、will strike？
questions.a: 'Had gathered' is the past perfect, showing the crowd had already come together earlier; 'would strike' is the future in the past, showing that twelve was still to come from that past moment.
questions.aZh: had gathered 是过去完成时，表“过去的过去”；would strike 是过去将来时，表当时看来将要发生的事。
questions.hint: 对照讲义注释：过去完成时表先完成，过去将来时表其后发生。

questions.q: Why did everybody begin to laugh and sing instead of getting angry at the broken clock?
questions.zh: 新年的钟声泡汤了，人们为何没有生气，反而又笑又唱？
questions.a: Because the clock's sudden silence was so unexpected and funny that people took it in good part: they laughed and welcomed the New Year by singing themselves.
questions.aZh: 因为大钟“罢工”的意外太滑稽，人们不以为恼，索性自己笑着唱起来迎接新年，显得幽默而乐观。
questions.hint: 抓住末句 At that moment 的转折，与标题 a cold welcome 形成反差。

exercises.q: 汉译英：新年前夜，一大群人聚集在市政厅的大钟下面。
exercises.a: On New Year's Eve, a large crowd of people gathered under the Town Hall clock.
exercises.note: crowd 表人群，聚集用 gather。

exercises.q: 汉译英：再过二十分钟，大钟就要敲响十二下了。
exercises.a: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
exercises.note: 过去将来时；in … time 表“之后”。

exercises.q: 用 at, on, in 填空：(1) ___ Wednesday evening (2) ___ five to twelve (3) ___ twenty minutes' time (4) ___ that moment
exercises.note: 某天晚上用 on，钟点用 at。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 refused to 改写，保持拟人语气。The big clock did not want to welcome the New Year.
exercises.a: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
exercises.note: refuse to do 表“不肯做”，可拟人。

exercises.q: 改错：My watch said it was two minutes passed twelve, but the big clock refused strike.
exercises.a: My watch said it was two minutes past twelve, but the big clock refused to strike.
exercises.note: past 表时间“过”；refuse 接 to do。

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的适当形式填空：When I entered the room, the clock ___ (strike) five, and then its big hands suddenly ___ (stop).
exercises.note: strike 过去式 struck，非 striked。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们等啊等啊，可什么也没有发生。就在那时，大家笑了起来，唱起了歌。
exercises.a: We waited and waited, but nothing happened. At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.
exercises.note: happen 主语为物；begin to do。

quiz.q: 课文中表示“一大群人已经聚集在市政厅大钟下”的正确表达是哪一项？
options: A large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
A large crowd of people have gathered under the Town Hall clock.
A large crowd of people had gathering under the Town Hall clock.
A large crowd of people was gather under the Town Hall clock.
quiz.note: had + 过去分词 gathered 构成过去完成时。

quiz.q: 表示“再过二十分钟，大钟将敲响十二下”，英文应选哪一项？
options: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
It would strike twelve after twenty minutes' time.
It will strike twelve for twenty minutes.
It would strike twelve twenty minutes ago.
quiz.note: in + 一段时间 + 's time 表“之后”，用于将来。

quiz.q: 表示“大钟敲响十二点”，正确的动词搭配是哪一项？
options: The clock struck twelve.
The clock hit twelve.
The clock beat twelve.
The clock knocked twelve.
quiz.note: 钟“敲响”用 strike，过去式 struck。

quiz.q: 下列哪一项正确表达了“那座大钟不愿意迎接新年”？
options: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
The big clock refused welcoming the New Year.
The big clock refused to welcoming the New Year.
The big clock denied to welcome the New Year.
quiz.note: refuse 后接 to do；此处为拟人手法。

quiz.q: 关于本课标题 a cold welcome 的构词，下列说法正确的是哪一项？
options: welcome 是名词，cold 作定语修饰，整体意为“冷遇”
welcome 是副词，用来修饰形容词 cold
cold welcome 是动词短语，意为“冷淡欢迎”
welcome 在此作连词，连接两个名词
quiz.note: 形容词 + 名词构成名词短语。

quiz.q: 课文中“星期三的晚上”所使用的正确介词搭配是哪一项？
options: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
In Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
At Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
During Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
quiz.note: 具体某一天的晚上用 on。
